topic: Gaban's Kamudo stopped Imu's Stigma finish during their duel on Elbaph, and it cost him his left arm
title: Gaban's Axes Stopped a God's Finishing Move
description: Scopper Gaban's duel with Nerona Imu on Elbaph is the fight most fans skip past. His Kamudo blocked Imu's Stigma finish, and Gaban paid for it with his left arm in chapter 1190. Here's the moment that makes his old-man reputation harder to dismiss.
comment: Is Gaban's fight with Imu the stronger line on his résumé, or does Rayleigh still have the edge?

lines.text: Scopper Gaban stopped a god's finishing move with his axes.

shot.fallback: old pirate with two axes, black lightning around the blades, anime style

lines.text: Luffy was pinned to a tree, and Imu was about to strike again.

shot.fallback: pale villain with a sword of flame above a young captain pinned to a tree, anime style

lines.text: So Gaban jumped in and charged both axes with Supreme King Haki.

shot.search: Scopper Gaban Supreme King Haki axes
shot.fallback: old pirate with two axes glowing with dark energy, anime style

lines.text: Black lightning ripped through the Adam Tree around the battlefield.

shot.fallback: enormous sacred tree with black lightning crackling through its branches

lines.text: Huge branches came crashing down before Imu even managed to block the strike.

shot.fallback: massive axe clash in a burst of sparks, anime style

lines.text: Then Gaban picked Luffy up by the shirt and scolded him for needing rescue.

shot.fallback: old pirate lifting a young captain by his collar, anime style

lines.text: He lost his left arm for that move.

shot.fallback: old pirate standing tall with one sleeve empty, dramatic light

lines.text: Think about that. A man that old held a god off to save Luffy.

shot.fallback: old pirate facing a pale god across a shattered tree, anime style

lines.text: And that's just one fight. The real test is how it stacks up against Rayleigh's.

shot.fallback: two old pirates standing side by side, dramatic sky

lines.text: Because a god's finishing move got stopped by one old pirate's axes.

shot.fallback: old pirate with two axes, dramatic light behind him

self_check.hook: Names Gaban in the first three words and sets up a fight with a visible stake (a god's finishing move).
self_check.loop: Last line opens with 'Because' and finishes the thought that line 1 started.
